headline: Divided Fronts See Fresh Strategic Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, the heaviest movement has broadened across the contested belt. Weathered Expanse now reports 26 strategic-base events in 24 hours, though activity has eased from its earlier two-hour rush; seven Warden bases, two Colonial, remain on the ledger. Fisherman’s Row has risen to 36 daily events, with three in the latest two hours, while its balance stands six Warden to three Colonial. Stlican Shelf records 12 events, including two recent, and remains split six to three. Farranac Coast has become another active sector, posting eight events and three in the latest watch, with nine Colonial bases to two Warden. Godcrofts has added two events in two hours and eight across the day, its map showing seven Warden bases and two neutral. Deadlands, divided four Warden to seven Colonial, logged five events in the day but none in the latest two-hour window. Lykos Isle and Oarbreaker retain notable daily histories but have gone quiet recently; elsewhere, long-held sectors show little or no base turnover.
